info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Workflow Transition Properties API

params.name: transitionId
params.description: The ID of the transition. To get the ID, view the workflow in text mode in the Jira administration console. The ID is shown next to the transition.

params.name: includeReservedKeys
params.description: Some properties with keys that have the *jira.* prefix are reserved, which means they are not editable. To include these properties in the results, set this parameter to *true*.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the property being returned, also known as the name of the property. If this parameter is not specified, all properties on the transition are returned.

params.name: workflowName
params.description: The name of the workflow that the transition belongs to.

params.name: workflowMode
params.description: The workflow status. Set to *live* for active and inactive workflows, or *draft* for draft workflows.

items.docs:
Returns the properties on a workflow transition. Transition properties are used to change the behavior of a transition. For more information, see [Transition properties](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/zIhKLg#Advancedworkflowconfiguration-transitionproperties) and [Workflow properties](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/JYlKLg).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

params.name: transitionId
params.description: The ID of the transition. To get the ID, view the workflow in text mode in the Jira admin settings. The ID is shown next to the transition.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the property being added, also known as the name of the property. Set this to the same value as the `key` defined in the request body.

params.name: workflowName
params.description: The name of the workflow that the transition belongs to.

params.name: workflowMode
params.description: The workflow status. Set to *live* for inactive workflows or *draft* for draft workflows. Active workflows cannot be edited.

Updates a workflow transition by changing the property value. Trying to update a property that does not exist results in a new property being added to the transition. Transition properties are used to change the behavior of a transition. For more information, see [Transition properties](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/zIhKLg#Advancedworkflowconfiguration-transitionproperties) and [Workflow properties](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/JYlKLg).
